reviews.body: Prometheus accepts both `info(up, {})` and `info(up, {job=~".*"})`. If the empty-matcher exception is deferred, change `Fixes #145` to `Refs #145` so the issue stays open.

review_comments.body: `info(up, +{job="api"})` still passes because the grammar discards unary `+` before this match. Prometheus keeps a `UnaryExpr` here and rejects the argument. Preserve that distinction through validation and add this case to the parser test.

Fixed: `info(up, +{job="api"})` is now rejected. The AST has no node for unary `+`, so instead of changing public types the grammar records it for the second argument and `info()` rejects it. Added to the parser test.
